    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">go项目使用go build 与 MakeFile 构建项目</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>转载请注明出处：</p>
<h2>一、Go Build 简要用法</h2>
<h3>核心作用</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">编译Go代码生成可执行文件</p>
</li>
<li>适合快速编译和简单项目</li>
</ul>
<h3>常用命令　</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"># 基本编译
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">go</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> build                      # 编译当前目录
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">go</span> build -o app ./cmd/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">main    # 指定输出文件

# 交叉编译
GOOS</span>=linux GOARCH=amd64 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">go</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> build  # Linux版本
GOOS</span>=windows <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">go</span> build             # Windows版本</pre>
</div>
<h3>应用</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1110857/202512/1110857-20251221175930692-416467610.png" alt="image" width="802" height="185" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2>二、Makefile 简要用法</h2>
<h3>核心作用</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">自动化构建流程，统一团队操作</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">管理复杂依赖关系和构建步骤</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">标准化开发、测试、部署流程</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3>基本结构</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"># 变量定义
APP </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> myapp
VERSION </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.0</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

# 目标: 依赖
build: fmt test
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">go</span> build -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">o $(APP)

# 伪目标
.PHONY: clean
clean:
    rm </span>-f $(APP)</pre>
</div>
<h3>关键优势</h3>
<ol start="1">
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">统一入口：团队使用相同命令</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">复杂流程简化：一键完成多个步骤</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">环境一致性：避免环境差异问题</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">文档作用：Makefile即构建文档</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h3>模板</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"># 最小可用 Makefile
.PHONY: help build test clean

help:
    @echo </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">make build - 编译项目</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    @echo </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">make test  - 运行测试</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    @echo </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">make clean - 清理文件</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

build:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">go</span> build -o bin/app ./cmd/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">main

test:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">go</span> test ./... -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">v

clean:
    rm </span>-rf bin/</pre>
</div>
<h3>应用：</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>EXE_LINUX=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">monitor
EXE_ARM64</span>=monitor-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">arm64
EXE_DBG_LINUX</span>=monitor-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">dbg
EXE_DBG_ARM64</span>=monitor-dbg-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">arm64

all: monitor monitor</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">arm64


monitor: commit_id
        mkdir </span>-p ../<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">bin
        GOOS</span>=linux GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">go</span> build -tags <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pe</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> -o ../bin/$(EXE_LINUX) ./cmd/monitor.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">go</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        cp .</span>/cmd/monitor_no.conf  ../bin/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">monitor.conf

monitor</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">arm64: commit_id
        mkdir </span>-p ../<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">bin
        GOOS</span>=linux GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">go</span> build -tags <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pe</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> -o ../bin/$(EXE_ARM64) ./cmd/monitor.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">go</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        cp .</span>/cmd/monitor_no.conf  ../bin/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">monitor.conf

monitor</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">dbg: commit_id
        mkdir </span>-p ../<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">bin
        GOOS</span>=linux GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">go</span> build -gcflags <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">all=-N -l</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> -tags <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pe</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> -o ../bin/$(EXE_DBG_LINUX) ./cmd/monitor.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">go</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

monitor</span>-dbg-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">arm64: commit_id
        mkdir </span>-p ../<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">bin
        GOOS</span>=linux GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">go</span> build -gcflags <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">all=-N -l</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> -tags <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pe</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> -o ../bin/$(EXE_DBG_ARM64) ./cmd/monitor.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">go</span></pre>
</div>
<p>运行编译：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>root@xdd-virtual-machine:~/zeng/terra-monitor-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">23</span>/terra-monitor/src# <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">make</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> all
mkdir </span>-p ../<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">bin
GOOS</span>=linux GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">go</span> build -tags <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pe</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> -o ../bin/monitor ./cmd/monitor.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">go</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
cp .</span>/cmd/monitor_no.conf  ../bin/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">monitor.conf
mkdir </span>-p ../<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">bin
GOOS</span>=linux GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">go</span> build -tags <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pe</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> -o ../bin/monitor-arm64 ./cmd/monitor.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">go</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
cp .</span>/cmd/monitor_no.conf  ../bin/monitor.conf</pre>
</div>
